why: Current resource-task native input exists only after admission and is PRIVATE. First fresh public root TTY input needs a real source before admission, not promotion of task stdin or an invented peer.

source_schema.extra_validation: Strict UTF8 raw bytes, 1..65536 bytes, no NUL; text is exact decode with no stripping/normalization. Canonical event_data has only text. Raw payload SHA/size bind original observed bytes separately; strict duplicate/nonfinite JSON rules when serialized.

producer.boundaries: Root-private registry observes actual foreground root TTY bytes itself, using existing RootRuntimeForegroundTTYObserver and root_setup controlling TTY/PIDFD/session/foreground checks plus actual current installed release/actor. No caller payload/source-kind/PUBLIC flag/recipient/profile metadata authority. No live expired RootBootstrapSession requirement. Active adopted choice/revocation/current policy and short current permission snapshot required every phase.

recipient_semantics: Logical initial-source recipient selection binds actual EnrolledPublicWebScope and current public-free-web-read permission, literal recipient public-web, zero additional metered budget, actual adopted source choice. It is not RootSelectedNativeExecution, a managed peer, a job admission or an effect grant. No native worker PIDFD exists yet and none is fabricated. Root generates a unique one-use initial selection handle in its retained registry.
observation_semantics: Actual raw bytes retained root-private, never in logs or authority argv; observer does not accept arbitrary worker/source-derived bytes. Prompt is finite fresh input capture, then displays exact public disclosure purpose/recipient/input hash+size and bounded text to current foreground TTY. Explicit PUBLIC answer required for these actual bytes. Existing normal config choice does not substitute for per-input disclosure; blank/EOF/other answer denies. No repeated setup config prompt.
source_controller: Introduce sealed RootForegroundTTYInputControllerProof produced only by this registry from actual current installed actor plus retained current foreground TTY observation and exact selected source-role/enrollment/schema joins. It is distinct from daemon RootIngressControllerProof: do not fabricate unit/MainPID, convert TTY into a daemon proof, or relax existing daemon validator. Event issuer accepts this exact type only for root-public-tty-observed-event-v1 and root-public-tty-initial-input-v1 source action. Verify original PIDFD/TTY/session/foreground/actor/source/current generation on each use.
source_fields: RootForegroundTTYInputControllerProof binds controller_proof_handle, recipient_selection_handle, actor_observation_sha256, tty_observation_handle, source_issuer_id, source_observer_enrollment_id, source_action_id, capture_schema_id, profile_id, namespace_id, profile_generation, service_generation_digest, issued_monotonic, expires_monotonic; issuer owns membership seal and actual held observations.
issuance: ResourceEventContextIssuer registers an exact selected producer capability for this controller-proof type and source schema. Canonical source event remains existing schema1 native-input envelope with controller/raw observation hashes, event_data, observed time and replay key. Issue actual signed HostContext and PUBLIC SourceReceipt only after exact disclosure validation. Context uses current selected principal/profile namespace and root foreground controller source proof, native process identity null before later peer selection. This is actual root-observed fresh source, not impersonation of worker.
ancestry: Fresh direct TTY capture has empty SourceReceipt parents only because registry attests no worker/history/private-derived bytes were accepted. Artifact/release receipts are supporting source evidence, not forged SourceReceipt parents. Any private/unknown parent or history augmentation denies this PUBLIC initial-source branch. Existing PRIVATE task/native/channel input paths remain unchanged. Source sensitivity PUBLIC, allowed recipient ceiling exactly selected public-web scope and zero budget; never widen RootPrivateInputConsentRegistry.
replay: SHA256 strict canonical JSON {recipient_selection_handle,consent_id,choice_epoch,revocation_epoch,tty_observation_handle,observation_id,input_sha256,input_size_bytes}. All values come from retained root records; root CSPRNG observation_id, not caller nonce. Atomic one-use disclosure/capture; replay denies.
lifetime: Original foreground TTY proof <=60s and current per-input permission/source lease <=30s, bounded by all current actor/controller/policy/choice expiries. Never extend old snapshot or setup expiry. Raw bytes zeroed on consume/deny/expiry. Durable config adoption alone is not per-effect authority.
order: current active adopted public choice/scope -> logical initial recipient selection
actual foreground TTY raw capture -> exact explicit per-input disclosure
root PUBLIC source event/receipt retained BEFORE job admission
job admission consumes same retained source ancestry and exact input SHA/size
actual managed native peer/package/loaded role observation -> v129 derive peer-bound delivery context/source handle
one-use delivery/write/EOF/take binds exact bytes and complete ancestry; any added PRIVATE context blocks public egress
